assessment.rationale: The Main KPI of 1,000,000,000 people with a secure legal identity is already met by a deployed, discoverable system: India's Aadhaar had generated about 1.447 billion deduplicated biometric digital identities by 2026 (https://uidai.gov.in/en/aadhaar-dashboard/enrollment-dashboard). The open-source MOSIP platform, which countries use to build the same kind of foundational ID, had about 118 million residents registered across 25 countries, with Nigeria migrating in 2025 (https://mosipdecode.hackerearth.com/challenges/hackathon/mosip-decode/custom-tab/about-mosip). The title's added condition, an identity the person controls, is not met at that scale: the EU Digital Identity Wallet, with selective disclosure, had shipped in only three of 27 member states by September 2026 (https://www.euronews.com/2026/09/16/eu-digital-wallet-24-of-27-members-will-miss-the-deadline). About 800 million people still lack any proof of legal identity (https://www.biometricupdate.com/202511/new-world-bank-data-shows-800m-people-worldwide-still-lack-legal-identity). Decision: hold, because the KPI as written is achieved. Honest limit: a re-scoped project with its own KPI, such as user-controlled identity for the people still without one, may be open work, but that is a new proposal, not this one.

additionalSearches.query: Aadhaar number of enrolments 1.4 billion 2025 UIDAI
additionalSearches.finding: UIDAI dashboard (May 2026) lists 144.66 crore (about 1.447 billion) Aadhaar numbers generated.

additionalSearches.query: MOSIP open source identity platform countries people registered 2025
additionalSearches.finding: MOSIP open-source foundational ID: about 118 million residents registered across 25 countries; Nigeria migrating from July 2025.

additionalSearches.query: World Bank ID4D people without proof of legal identity 850 million 2025
additionalSearches.finding: ID4D-Findex 2025: about 800 million people lack proof of legal identity, down from 850 million in 2021; about 3 billion out of reach of digital ID.

additionalSearches.query: EU Digital Identity Wallet rollout 2026 self-sovereign user controlled verifiable credentials adoption
additionalSearches.finding: By September 2026 only three EU states had delivered an EUDI wallet; 24 of 27 expected to miss the December 2026 deadline.
